title: Northgate Marketplace Keep-It Refunds on Requests Answered Without Return
content:
**Keep-it refunds.** Under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, when a seller answers a buyer's return request with a refund without return, the buyer keeps the item and the refund the seller agreed is booked on the requested line for the units the request named. Northgate books the keep-it refund this policy fixes on the requested line; where it comes to zero while no return refund is yet recorded on the requested line, the request is not settled in this conversation and is referred to a human representative.

**Return rule in force around keep-it refunds.** For a keep-it refund within this policy's scope, and only for such a refund, the keep-it refund this policy fixes takes the place of the return rule's price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum on an opened change-of-mind return; a restocking top-up on such an order follows its own policy; and every other seller refund, including every refund on an order paid with a Northgate Card, still follows the return rule: the seller must refund within the program's seller refund time in business days after the return is delivered the price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum percentage on an opened change-of-mind return, plus the original shipping charge where the reason is a seller fault and never for a change of mind.

**How the refund is booked.** The agent unlocks the agent tool `refund_keepit_units_1db7244d` and calls it. One call books a return refund on the item line of that return request for the units the request named, of the amount given, with no restocking fee recorded, credited to the external card the order was paid with, and lowers the order's net amount paid by that amount; the buyer sees the refund on the order history and keeps the item.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `request_event_id` | the reference number of the return request the seller answered with a refund without return, read from the order history lookup (a return request entry of the order); text |
| `amount_refunded_usd` | the refund in US dollars, a positive number with exactly two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** On success: "Refund <refund_reference> of USD <amount> booked on line <line_event_id> for <units> unit(s) of request <request_event_id>, credited to the external card; order <market_order_id> net paid now USD <net_paid>." The refund reference is the sign that the refund was booked. The tool answers with an error when the reference is not a return request, when the request was not answered with a refund without return, when the order was not paid with an external card, or when the amount is not positive with exactly two decimal places.
